revealed.quote: Mercedes-Benz revised and updated the W163 in 2001 for the 2002 model year.

changes.text: New headlamp and tail-lamp lenses and new front and rear bumpers were fitted.

changes.text: The side turn signals moved from the fenders to the door mirrors.
changes.quote: the relocation of the side turn signals from the fenders to the side-view mirrors

changes.text: The ML 430 was replaced by the 5.0-litre V8 ML 500, and the 4.0-litre V8 ML 400 CDI diesel became available in Europe.
changes.quote: At the same time, the ML 430 was replaced by the 5.0-liter V8-powered ML 500 and a new 4.0-liter V8 turbodiesel ML 400 CDI became available in Europe.

changes.text: More than 1,100 components were renewed.
changes.quote: Mit der Modellpflege wurden mehr als 1100 Bauteile erneuert

notes: Mercedes-Benz press material (group-media.mercedes-benz.com, mercedes-benz.com) returns HTTP 403 to our research tool; this generation is documented from English and German Wikipedia.

Built at the Mercedes-Benz U.S. International plant in Vance, Alabama (MBUSI, Tuscaloosa County) – the first Mercedes-Benz passenger-car plant in the US; some European-market cars were also built by Magna Steyr in Graz, Austria (1999–2002).
North American model years 1998–2005. Production dates differ: English Wikipedia gives February 1997 – December 2004, German Wikipedia 1997–2005.
The models were badged 'ML' (e.g. ML 320) although the series was called M-Class.
English Wikipedia says the W163 seated five, or seven with an optional third row; no numeric source for seating was found, so seating is not recorded.

changes.text: The body-on-frame construction of the W163 was replaced by a unibody shared with the GL-Class.
changes.quote: The W164 platform used for the new M-Class is shared with the new GL-Class and is a unibody type rather than the former (W163) body-on-frame used by the M-Class vehicles produced from 1998–2005.

changes.text: The new model is 71 mm larger, 150 mm longer and 5 mm lower than the first generation.
changes.quote: Mercedes-Benz made the new M-Class 71 mm larger, 150 mm longer and 5 mm lower than the first model.

changes.text: The drag coefficient was reduced to 0.34.
changes.quote: The coefficient of drag was reduced to 0.34.

changes.text: The 7G-Tronic seven-speed automatic was introduced and the manual transmission was dropped.
changes.quote: New features in the 2006 M-Class include the 7G-Tronic seven-speed automatic transmission

changes.text: The standard transfer case lost its low range, which became part of an optional Off-Road Pro package outside the US.
changes.quote: In most countries except the U.S., an Off-Road Pro package with center and rear differential locks, 4-ETS, two-speed transfer case with reduction gearing, and adjustable ground clearance was available as an option

revealed.quote: The 2009 Mercedes-Benz M-Class got a minor facelift as it debuted at the 2008 New York International Auto Show in March 2008.

changes.text: New headlights, redesigned bumpers, new mirrors and a larger grille were introduced.
changes.quote: This facelift includes new front headlights, redesigned front and rear bumpers, new exterior mirrors, new rim choices, a larger front grille, restyled interior

changes.text: Diesel model designations were raised (ML 280 CDI to ML 300 CDI, 320 CDI to 350 CDI, 420 CDI to 450 CDI).
changes.quote: The ML 280 CDI became the ML 300 CDI, the 320 CDI became the 350 CDI, and the 420 CDI became the 450 CDI.

changes.text: BlueTec diesels with urea injection arrived for the 2009 model year.
changes.quote: Models using Bluetec Diesel engine with urea injection were introduced in 2008 for the 2009 model year.

changes.text: PRE-SAFE preventive occupant protection and NECK-PRO head restraints became standard.
changes.quote: Ferner wurde die M-Klasse serienmäßig mit dem präventiven Insassenschutz PreSafe und NeckPro-Kopfstützen ausgestattet.

notes: Mercedes-Benz press material returns HTTP 403 to our research tool; documented from English and German Wikipedia.
Built only at Vance (Tuscaloosa County), Alabama. North American model years 2006–2011.

Dates differ between sources: English Wikipedia gives production from January 2005; German Wikipedia gives 03/2005–06/2011 in its infobox and July 2011 in the text for the end of production. German Wikipedia gives slightly different dimensions (4,780 × 1,911 × 1,815 mm, wheelbase 2,915 mm).
German Wikipedia says the facelift was shown at the end of April 2008 and delivered from autumn 2008; English Wikipedia dates its debut to the New York show in March 2008.
The ML 450 Hybrid (2009 New York show) was offered only in the United States, on lease.

changes.text: Rear legroom was increased and the rear backrests became adjustable.

changes.text: The M-Class was renamed GLE, positioning it as the SUV counterpart of the E-Class.
changes.quote: This is followed by the letter "L" that acts as a linkage with the letter "E"—the GLE being the SUV equivalent to the E-Class.

changes.text: The GLE 500 e became the first plug-in hybrid in the range, combining a V6 with an electric motor.
changes.quote: The GLE 500 e is the first plug-in hybrid in this model range, combining a 333 hp V6 engine with a 116 hp electric motor.

changes.text: Rear-wheel drive became available for the first time.
changes.quote: Erstmals war er auch mit Hinterradantrieb bestellbar.

changes.text: From 2015 all production moved to the Vance, Alabama plant.
changes.quote: before all production moved to the U.S. plant near Vance, Alabama in 2015 with the release of the facelifted W166 model

notes: Name by date: sold as the M-Class (ML badges) from 2011 and as the GLE from the 2015 facelift (shown at New York in April 2015, delivered in Europe from August 2015). The rename is recorded as revision r1.

GLE Coupé (C292): a coupé SUV body on the W166 platform, unveiled at the North American International Auto Show in Detroit in January 2015 and built in Alabama; German Wikipedia gives market launch July 2015 and English Wikipedia says it was discontinued in August 2019. It is recorded as body style b2 of this generation.
Mercedes-Benz global press material returns HTTP 403 to our research tool; US specifications come from the Mercedes-Benz USA media newsroom (media.mbusa.com), which is readable.
North American model years 2012–2019. Production end: English Wikipedia gives 2019, German Wikipedia 2018 (W166 SUV); the C292 coupé ran until 2019.

English Wikipedia also says the W166 was built in Stuttgart for Europe and Australia from 2011 to 2015; German Wikipedia says it was built in Tuscaloosa. This claim is not recorded. Pune and Bogor performed final assembly of kits shipped from Vance (English Wikipedia).

changes.text: Length, width, wheelbase and track width all increased.
changes.quote: Revised dimensional concept (Increased length, width, wheelbase, track width)

changes.text: A 9-speed 9G-TRONIC automatic is used on all models.

changes.text: The six-cylinder GLE 450 uses a 48-volt system with an integrated starter-generator (EQ Boost) adding up to 21 hp.
changes.quote: This integrated electric motor system, known as EQ Boost, assists the combustion engine by adding up to 21 hp for short periods of time.

changes.text: A third seat row became available.
changes.quote: The interior is even more spacious and comfortable, with a newly available third row seat.

changes.text: The MBUX infotainment system with voice control and twin 12.3-inch displays was introduced.

changes.text: A new steering wheel with touch-sensitive surfaces on the horizontal spokes was introduced.

notes: Series code: German Wikipedia and Mercedes-Benz media captions cited by English Wikipedia use 'V 167' for the SUV; the English Wikipedia infobox gives 'W167'. The coupé is C 167. The V 167 code is recorded.
GLE Coupé (C 167): presented at the IAA in Frankfurt in September 2019 with first deliveries in spring 2020 (German Wikipedia); recorded as body style b2.
Built at Vance, Alabama for most markets (North American model years 2020 onward); a locally built long-wheelbase GLE L for China (Beijing Benz) was announced from 2026 (Wikipedia).

Mercedes-Benz global press material returns HTTP 403 to our research tool; US specifications come from the Mercedes-Benz USA media newsroom (media.mbusa.com). English Wikipedia's engine table does not state markets, so those entries are recorded with market 'unstated' (European plug-in hybrids are marked EU where the text says so).
The 2023 facelift went on sale in July 2023 (German Wikipedia) for the 2024 model year in the US. A second facelift for the 2027 model year was unveiled in March 2026.
